entries.087f7eaddffc21f6: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥218,329 million, up from ¥214,890 million in the previous year. The background includes a sharp weakening of the yen, among other factors.
entries.268439a94d3f9444: This business manufactures and sells press dies and surface grinders. Dies are also used for component production within the group, and revenue from external customers was ¥4,112 million in the fiscal year ended January 2026.

entries.31ca4376f01fccac: This business manufactures and sells motor core products and other items. It centers on drive and generator motor cores for electric vehicles, and sales to Toyota Motor Corporation, the main customer, were ¥69,421 million in the fiscal year ended January 2026. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥154,649 million, accounting for about 7 tenths of consolidated net sales.
entries.3acf2d066f3c71de: Mitsui High-tec is a components manufacturer based in Kitakyushu, Fukuoka Prefecture, that makes motor cores for electric vehicles, lead frames for semiconductors, and dies and machine tools.
entries.400a18ad930f7ad2: The group consists of the company and 14 consolidated subsidiaries, 15 companies in total. Its headquarters is located in Kitakyushu City, Fukuoka Prefecture, and the “Mitsui” in its name derives from the surname of its founder, Takaaki Mitsui. Consolidated employees as of the fiscal year ended January 2026 numbered 4,858.
entries.465af259d7f0fd74: The company manufactures and sells drive and power-generation motor cores for electrified vehicles, lead frames that serve as terminals for semiconductor packages, and press dies and surface grinders used to mass-produce them, at bases in Asia, the Americas and Europe.
entries.a85f35ab8a9996fd: It has an integrated system in which it develops and produces dies in-house and uses those dies to mass-produce motor cores and lead frames. Built around ultra-precision machining technology, it has a global supply system with production bases in Asia, the Americas and Europe.
entries.ac6183240639f4b5: As its corporate creed since its founding, it cites “Make products that are useful to people around the world,” “Adhere to the principle of mutual benefit and mutual goodwill, and seek mutual profit,” and “Build a paradise for workers based on the spirit of equality,” and it places “Save energy. Save earth. Save life.” at the core of its management guidelines. The medium-term management plan announced in March 2025 was revised in light of the growth of the electrified vehicle market and the slower recovery of the legacy semiconductor market, and the sales target for the fiscal year ending January 2028 is set at ¥263 billion.
entries.ad2959d63bcc2c98: Its main customers are in the automotive and semiconductor industries. Revenue from Toyota Motor, its major customer, was ¥69,421 million in the fiscal year ended January 2026.

entries.c81f9f22c2ec819f: This business manufactures and sells lead frames and other products that serve as terminals for semiconductor packages. Production is also carried out at consolidated subsidiaries in Singapore, Malaysia, China and Taiwan. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥59,567 million.
entries.dc94d09833621154: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥3,151 million, down from ¥12,219 million in the previous year. The main reasons include the recording of impairment losses related to transactions with some customers, in response to slowing growth in the electric vehicle market in Europe.
